title: Looking for fast-paced crossword apps for simultaneous play
author: Norah_Stiles
selftext:
I use crossword and word apps as "fidget toys" for stress relief. Because of this, I play very fast and cannot stand waiting for turns. I need an app where I can play multiple games all at once to keep the momentum going.  
I previously used Wordfeud with a paid subscription. It scratched the itch perfectly at first, but I recently deleted it because it was completely filled with bots, scammers, and phishing attempts.

I have looked through most of the mainstream apps and am coming up empty. Are there any clean, serious crossword or word game apps that support rapid, multi-game play against real people (or highly reliable, non-scam systems) without the social media spam?  
Thanks much! :)
